title: Khet Sathi version stamp: site/data/version.json
description: Owner's launch brief (2026-11-14): which version of the repository the site's files were checked at, for the How-we-know page. Written by scripts/final_check.py before its checks run. commit is the commit the files were checked at; the stamp itself is committed after it, so the published commit is the next one. uncommitted_changes is true when files other than this stamp had changes not yet committed when the check ran.
